description:
Replace the two local counting wrappers in the pinned-read tests with the shared counting stand-in, so one fixture counts git processes.

## Background

- The behaviour suite and the storage capture tests each write their own `#!/bin/sh` wrapper that logs `$*` and runs `exec git "$@"` (`counted_git`, `crates/jit/tests/fast_docs_templates/git_revision_tests.rs:166-181`; `capture_git_fixture`, `crates/jit/src/storage/repository_state_store_tests.rs:2585-2632`), pass it as the program through `with_git_program`, and match logged lines by their first word (`crates/jit/tests/fast_docs_templates/git_revision_tests.rs:364`, `:435`; `crates/jit/src/storage/repository_state_store_tests.rs:2671`, `:2764`).
- `jit::test_harness` provides a counting stand-in that can be passed as an explicit program and records each invocation's arguments with a leading `-C <dir>` pair removed, so its records stay the same when the reads start running through the git module.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Both files count processes with the shared stand-in, and neither defines its own wrapper or log reader.
- [hard] REQ-02: Their process counts and subcommands are unchanged.

## Notes

- Written against the code as it stands after the changes this one follows; line citations name current code.
title: Pinned-read tests count processes with the shared stand-in
